name: Core checks
description: What bridge-commander itself needs on this machine: tmux, git and a git identity at init; gh and treehouse at boot.

checks.title: tmux is installed
checks.hint: brew install tmux (macOS) or apt install tmux (Debian/Ubuntu)

checks.title: git is installed
checks.hint: brew install git (macOS) or apt install git (Debian/Ubuntu)

checks.exec: git config user.name && git config user.email
checks.title: git has an identity (user.name and user.email)
checks.hint: git config --global user.name "Your Name" && git config --global user.email you@example.com

checks.title: gh (GitHub CLI) is installed
checks.hint: the PR watch (a merged PR archives its card) needs gh: brew install gh, then gh auth login

checks.title: treehouse is installed
checks.hint: optional; git worktree is used otherwise
